title: teucrium townsendii subsp. affine
intro: Teucrium townsendii subsp. affine, commonly known as Western Mountain Tea, is a plant species native to North America. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. Western Mountain Tea is also believed to have therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and diterpenoids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
